Functional viability of both types of synaptic structures was demonstrated through KCl-induced depolarization, which triggered phosphorylation changes in growth cone proteins (GAP43, MARCKS, MARCKSL1), cytoskeletal regulators (DCLK1, SHTN1, MARK4, MAP1B) and protein kinases (CAMK2G, PRKCE) in Day 90 GCPs, as well as classical synaptic vesicle cycle proteins (SYN1, DNM1, RPH3A) at Day 150.
